transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I can’t really keep my mind on one thing lately. At work, at the bench, I’ll go from a customer email to a saw mark to some noise outside, and then I realize I’ve completely lost track of the work order. It’s been... hard to manage.
Do you find yourself getting easily distracted by things around you even when you're not at work?
Yeah… it’s not just at work. My mind just won’t stay put on one thing. Even small stuff around me can pull me off, and then I realize I’ve lost what I was doing.
Do you have trouble organizing your daily tasks or activities?

Yeah… I do. It’s gotten pretty bad. I missed a big custom delivery, and my shop records are such a mess I had to stop taking new work for now. My family’s been checking in on me more, too… I guess they’re worried I’m not keeping up like I usually do.
Do you have trouble remembering things that happened recently?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I lose track of what I’m doing sometimes, but I haven’t noticed, like, forgetting recent things in a clear way.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?

Yeah… kind of. It’s more like I can’t sit on an idea. I started trying to line up new commissions, messaging old customers, planning a website, sketching a whole Appalachian collection… all at once. Like it all had to happen right then.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. I don’t really think of it that way. I just get moving on something and don’t always stop to sort it out first.
Have you noticed any problems in your relationships with family or friends because of acting on impulse or not thinking things through?

Yeah… some. My family’s been checking on me more lately. I guess they got worried because I wasn’t keeping up with my usual stuff.

And work got messy too. I missed a big custom delivery, and my shop records got so disorganized I had to stop taking new work for now. So… yeah, it’s caused problems.
Do you feel overwhelmed or stressed when you're unable to focus or complete tasks?

Yeah… I do. That’s honestly kind of what brought me in.

At the bench, I’ll try to work on one order, and then I’m checking a customer email, then staring at some saw mark, then I hear something outside… and by the time I look back, I’ve lost track of the whole work order. It gets pretty overwhelming.
Do you often feel like you're constantly on the go or like you can't slow down?

Yeah… I guess so. At the bench I couldn’t really sit still. I’d start sketching a watch case, then jump to emailing suppliers, then rearrange the display trays… even after closing. Just kind of kept going.
Do you often have mood swings?
Yeah… I mean, I guess after the show especially. I’d feel really up, like… bigger than myself, and then if someone told me to slow down or keep normal shop hours, I’d snap at them. Not proud of it.
Have you had to stop doing things you enjoy or change your daily routine because of these symptoms?

Yeah… I’ve had to change things. I’m not really taking new work right now.

I missed a big custom delivery, and the shop records got… pretty messed up. My family’s been checking in more too, because I guess I got pretty far off my normal routine.
Have you noticed any significant problems in your relationships or work due to your difficulty with focus and impulsivity?

Yeah… it’s caused problems. I missed a major custom delivery, and my shop records got so disorganized I’ve had to stop taking new work for now.

My family’s been checking on me more too. I think they got worried because I was pretty far off my usual routine.
Do you often find yourself talking more than others in social situations?
I’m not sure. I don’t really pay attention to that. Maybe sometimes, but… I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed it a lot.
Do you often dominate conversations when you're with others?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say I dominate them. I guess maybe I can talk a bit, but I haven’t really noticed that.
Have you felt like your symptoms are interfering with your ability to function in daily life?

Yeah… I think so. It’s gotten in the way more than I’d like to admit. I missed a big custom delivery, and my shop records got so messy I had to stop taking new work for now. My family’s been checking in more too… I think they noticed I wasn’t keeping up with my normal routine.
Are you feeling distressed or upset by the problems you're having with focus and impulsivity?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t like saying it, but it’s upsetting. The main thing is my mind just won’t stay on one thing. At the bench I’ll go from a customer email, to some tiny saw mark, to a noise outside, and then I realize I’ve lost track of the whole work order. It’s… frustrating.
How long have you been experiencing these difficulties with focus and impulsivity?
It was… right after I got that award at the jewelry show. That’s when it really started feeling wired and out of control. It lasted about two weeks, I think.
Have your symptoms been constant since they started after the jewelry show, or have they come and go?
It wasn’t really constant after that. The wired, out-of-control part started right after the jewelry show award, and it went on for… about two weeks.
Have your symptoms lasted for at least six months?
No… not six months. It was more like that stretch after the jewelry show award — about two weeks.
Have you experienced any periods of significant focus or impulsivity problems before the two weeks after the jewelry show award?

Before that? Not really like this. The main thing was when I’d be at the bench and my mind just wouldn’t stay put — I’d go from an email to a saw mark to some noise outside, and then realize I’d lost track of the whole work order.
